source_bounded_domain.theory: R>0, m5>0, finite Lambda>=max(m5,mh), positive finite mass matrix, and all retained eigenmasses below Lambda

flags_raised: every m5 = 1200 GeV point exceeds the |mu5/sqrt(Lambda)| < 1 convention at mu4_max; at R^-1 = 10 and 100 GeV it also exceeds lambda0 <= 1

selected_restricted_test.interpretation: The restricted hypothesis predicts kappa_V = kappa_F = kappa <= 1 and therefore contains the SM decoupling limit, so this data set can bound mu4 but cannot refute the restricted model. The result is conditional compatibility, not evidence for Candidate B.
